H1.pregunta: Why do I keep waking up in front of the Mouth?
H1.respuesta: The Chamber, at the heart of the Workshop, holds the last fifteen minutes with a power source; the skeptic built it, and taking the source out cuts the loop.

H2.respuesta: Every use of a Gate drifts its two clocks apart; past the Limit it collapses, and the network spreads the collapse to all of them.

H3.respuesta: They died fleeing through the very Gates that condemned them; the evacuation sped up the cascade, and its fluctuations switched off gates that left two of them shut in.

H4.respuesta: The Council hid the danger; the scientist and the skeptic worked in secret.

H5.respuesta: At a place where time runs fast, hidden behind the lens of the Knot: what you see in the sky is displaced.

H6.respuesta: By replacing the engine of the Scar machine with the Counterweight, its clock synchronised, during the pulse; and the Counterweight only has power with the loop's power source.

H7.pregunta: How and when do I get home?
H7.respuesta: The mouths have different clocks: you must leave by the one that arrives before the Institute's great test.

H8.pregunta: Who were the two who stayed behind?
H8.respuesta: They loved each other. They wanted the same thing by different roads and they parted; each holds half of what is needed and they cannot put the halves together.
